message.content:
In modulo \(31\):

\[
3^{-1} \equiv 21 \pmod{31}
\]
since \(3 \cdot 21 = 63 \equiv 1 \pmod{31}\).

\[
5^{-1} \equiv 25 \pmod{31}
\]
since \(5 \cdot 25 = 125 \equiv 1 \pmod{31}\).

So,

\[
3^{-1}+5^{-1} \equiv 21+25 = 46 \equiv 15 \pmod{31}.
\]

Now we need the inverse of \(15\) modulo \(31\). Since

\[
15 \cdot 29 = 435 = 31 \cdot 14 + 1,
\]

we have

\[
15^{-1} \equiv 29 \pmod{31}.
\]

The answer is 29.
